_comment: Tests that may not skip in the hosted Linux node job (VYRE_MUST_RUN=1, set after the job installs what they need: bubblewrap, gocryptfs, fuse3 and a loop-mounted ext4 with fscrypt for VYRE_FSCRYPT_DIR). A name prefix per file, or "*" for every test of the file. scripts/test-counts.mjs fails the run when one of them reports skip. Needs a prepared box and is not here yet: core/computers/image/isolation.test.js (a running computer container, VYRE_COMPUTER_CONTAINER).
